author: gravity215
quote:
If you know the old Fromsoftware games like King‘s Field and want to play it in a more modern way, you should play Queen‘s Domain(nice choice for the game name :D)

This is my personal GOTY. You will explore so many hours in a retro-Souls style game and it will make you addicted. This is an underrated gem, you should check it out!
